Galaxy Watch Ultra is the most durable smartwatch in Samsung's history, specifically designed to cope with the harshest environments: From the scorching heat of the desert to the bitter cold of snowy mountain peaks. Round cushion-shaped case Cushion Design Made of level 4 Titanium material, providing remarkable impact resistance.

The physical Quick Button allows you to activate a high-power 86 decibel emergency siren that can be heard up to 180 meters away in dangerous rescue situations.
